tests.notes: Only the three requested final-review regressions were exercised. The independent backend/integration file ran three tests: patient-only acknowledgment with current transport ID/version and coordinator waiting passed; picked_up completion with nonblank evidence plus return_pending escalation passed; staff open-to-assign then assigned-to-acknowledge failed on the second command because the persisted in-memory aggregate state no longer contains work_item_type. The frontend command-planner suite passed 2/2. The first focused Playwright invocation served a stale ignored dist and failed both selectors; after the required current frontend build, the exact two focused Chromium journeys passed 2/2. This was a deterministic build-artifact precondition, not a flaky retry, and is reported explicitly. No unchanged broad suite, live provider call, or Railway operation was run.

blockers.description: WorkflowApplication.workItem persists aggregateState with only status after assign. The next acknowledge command receives no work_item_type and workItemDraft rejects it as outside the public demo policy.
blockers.suggestion: Preserve the existing aggregate state, especially work_item_type, when applying each work-item status transition; then rerun only tests/server/final-review-regressions.test.ts.
